text:
jamie: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> prod. Progressive shift 10%/25%/50%/100%. Preflight green, proceeding. Deploy bot will post progress.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: v2.14.0 -> prod.
Traffic policy: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (5m between steps).
Monitors: p95 latency < 300ms, errors < 0.5%.
Alerts suppressed for deploy window: latency-guard.

alex: Quick check — can someone confirm SLO snapshot before shift? link: https://dash.internal/releases/v2-14/snapshot

maria: Taking snapshot now. Results:
```
service: all-prod
p95: 282ms
errors_total: 0.12%
5xx_rate: 0.07%
```
all green from our side, proceeding with 10%.

deploy-bot: Traffic at 10%.

sre-bot: Note: alert suppression active for latency-guard until 6162027200. Other alerts still enabled.

deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 25%.

maria: Observability note — small 5xx bump on embeddings route in eu-west. Spike at +0.9% over baseline for last 2m. Graph: https://dash.internal/graph/embeds-eu-west

devon: Seeing KV cache miss logs pointing to redis timeout around the same window. Snippet:
```
ts=2026-03-20T18:39:12Z svc=embeddings err=redis.timeout latency_ms=120
```

alex: Can we pin embeddings route back to v2.13.7 while we triage? Command:
`./pin-route --route=embeddings-prod --version=2.13.7 --reason='post-deploy 5xx spike'`

maria: Recommend holding rollout at 25% and pin embeddings route. If 5xx > 0.5% for 5m we rollback that route. Agree?

jamie: Agreed. Pin embeddings route, hold global rollout at 25%.

deploy-bot: Route pin executed: embeddings-prod -> 2.13.7 (by jamie). Holding traffic at 25% for 10 minutes for verification.

sre-bot: Post-pin SLO snapshot (embeddings-prod, eu-west):
```
5m_window: p95=298ms, 5xx=0.11%, errors_total=0.14%
```
Spike subsided after pin.

devon: I'll open a ticket and add a note to release notes: 'Known issue: embeddings route regression observed in v2.14.0; pinned to 2.13.7 pending fix.' Adding to draft release notes now.

maria: Once embeddings is stable for 15m we can resume traffic to 50% for remaining services. Keep me pinged.

jamie: Thanks all. Adding post-deploy follow-up: assign to devon for root cause and to product for release note update. :thumbsup:
